findings.finding: Company signalled upside to its '>8%' FY26 adjusted net profit guide (expects to meet the annual target 'comfortably' and did not rule out positive surprises; H2 expected stronger with 2,100 MW commissioning and better transmission tariffs), and at 9M 2025 it raised guidance, so a 9M guidance nudge-up is a live possibility.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 9M 2025 (2025-10-28) guidance raised to ~EUR 6.6bn: +3.42% close-to-close; Q1 2026 (2026-04-29) raise to >8%: -1.22%; H1 2026 (2026-07-22) reaffirm plus beat: -0.23% (Yahoo IBE.MC daily closes).
findings.original_quote: "espera cumplir el objetivo anual con holgura y no descartó que haya sorpresas positivas" (expects to meet the annual target comfortably and did not rule out positive surprises)
findings.why_not_priced: The guide on record is still '>8%'; a formal raise is a new number only the release can deliver. If a raise were fully priced the stock would not have sold its last two upgrades/beats and consensus targets (EUR 20.54) would not sit below spot; partly priced through the +26.6% YTD run, hence sized well under the 9M25 +3.4% reaction.
findings.independence: H1 release commentary on a stronger H2 (2,100 MW by December, improved transmission tariffs): https://thecorner.eu/?p=126951 ; Morningstar called the guide conservative: https://global.morningstar.com/es/acciones/resultados-de-iberdrola-se-elevan-las-previsiones-para-2026

findings.finding: Pre-released 9M operating data are net supportive for Q3: production +8.2% in Q3 (hydro +5.3%, offshore +16% 9M) and UK distribution +22.8%, against Spain onshore wind -12.4% in Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Operating-data releases are not separately priced events; H1 2026 adjusted beat (EUR 3,570m vs 3,380m est. per Bankinter) produced -0.23%.
findings.original_quote: snippet_only (iberdrola.com returns 403 to curl and WebFetch): Iberdrola distribuyó hasta septiembre cerca de 207.000 GWh de electricidad, un 5,8% más, impulsada por Reino Unido; producción 90.560 GWh (+3%)
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: published 12 days before the print to the CNMV. Only the translation into Q3 margin (networks tariff indexation, hydro mix) is not yet visible; that residual is why it is near zero.

findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 raise -1.22%, H1 2026 beat -0.23%: recent good news sold.
findings.original_quote: precio objetivo medio de 23 analistas 20,54 euros; 16 de 23 recomiendan mantener (paraphrase of the article's table; title: 'Iberdrola afronta octubre con una valoración exigente')

findings.finding: Rate backdrop turned against utilities: the ECB hiked in September 2026 to 2.50% while Iberdrola's net debt rose to EUR 54.0bn at H1 (+EUR 3.8bn vs Dec), a financial-cost headwind that may show in the 9M financial result or a cautious debt comment.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed print where financial cost was the surprise line.
findings.original_quote: tipo del BCE 2,50% (tras la subida de septiembre); deuda neta 53.972 millones de euros (paraphrase of figures in the article)
findings.why_not_priced: Macro-to-company transmission, a hypothesis: the hike is public and Iberdrola's debt is mostly fixed-rate, so only a guide or call comment would make it company-specific; hence small.
findings.independence: Net debt EUR 53,972m and its rise confirmed by the H1 coverage: https://thecorner.eu/?p=126951
